Inventory Movement

The Inventory Movement report tracks quantity changes for inventory items over a specified period.

View opening quantities, purchases, sales, adjustments, and closing balances for each item.

This report helps identify stock movements, detect discrepancies, and plan reorder points.

Configure date ranges to analyze seasonal trends or verify physical inventory counts.

Filter by specific items, locations, or categories to focus your inventory analysis.

Description

Enter an optional description or title for this report to help identify it later.

From

Select the starting date for the inventory movement analysis. Opening balances will be calculated as of this date.

To

Select the ending date for the inventory movement analysis. All movements between the from and to dates will be included.

Exclude inventory items with no movement

Check this box to hide inventory items that had no movement during the selected period. This helps focus on active inventory items only.
